note: What a C twin cannot say. An `untwinned` entry names an original the Python seat twins and C does not, a `declined` entry one assert-family form a twin does not prove; each names the spelling C is missing and the work it waits on. tools/twin_lane.py reads both: a declined form lowers what its twin owes, and an untwinned entry answers the scope rule.
